purpose: Text contrast regressions independently observed in the running app. Ordinary UI text must meet at least4.5:1 against its rendered background.

cases.name: Finding detail text remains readable on its card
Source domain text remains readable in a selected source row

verificationScope: Executable DOM stylesheet checks cover these text/background pairs. Parent browser audit covers actual computed colors, other text roles, font sizes, and responsive layout. This file does not claim all app contrast pairs have been tested.
